*.text: Wisconsin context: the whole state is in MISO. We Energies, Wisconsin Public Service, Alliant, Madison Gas and Electric, Xcel and Dairyland file at the Public Service Commission of Wisconsin, whose filing system (ERF) is open without a sign-in; the files are in batches/us-wi/harvest/psc_dockets.json and scopes/us-wi/work/psc/. The Department of Natural Resources air permit record (WARP) is in scopes/us-wi/work/permits/<plant_id>.md. Wisconsin has no resource plan rule; the plans that play that role are listed in scopes/us-wi/irp_plans.json. Amalia Llano edited 27 Wisconsin rows between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-15 (notes starting ALQ42026); treat the export values as her baseline and stage a change against one only when a verified document disagrees, and say which document.

Fitchburg (Madison Gas and Electric, Dane County, EIA plant 3991): two 28.8 MW combustion turbines from 1973, 57.6 MW, operating. GEM lacks it. Add it on the EIA record plus one document, after the duplicate check.

Elk Mound (Dairyland Power Cooperative, Chippewa County, EIA plant 7863): two 35.5 MW turbines from 2001, 71 MW, operating. GEM lacks it. Add it on the EIA record plus one document. The air permit facility number is 13798522.

Port Washington docket 6630-CE-318 is We Energies' application for a Certificate of Authority to upgrade the combustion turbines at the existing Port Washington Generating Station (101 filings). Concord docket 6630-CE-315 is an application to overhaul the existing combustion turbines at Concord units 1 to 4 in Watertown. Read each application for what changes (capacity, in-service date, conversion) and update the existing units; neither is a new plant.

MISO queue rows to place: J4164 (Dane County, 1,203 MW, Cleanview calls it North Madison), J3156 (Rock County, 100 MW), J4179 and J4184 (American Transmission Company, 735 and 755 MW, 2030), S1090, J4115, J4116, J3936, J4014, J4028 and J4165. Match each to a GEM plant or a lead, or add it at announced on the queue row. Forest Junction must not be counted twice against the Cleanview 650 MW row.

Data centers to settle: Microsoft Mount Pleasant (permits 24-DMM-092 and 25-MIN-113 against the August 2026 application for 244 generators and 687 MW, and about 150 more generators proposed at a third site), Microsoft Kenosha and Caledonia, Vantage Lighthouse WI-1 and any later phase, Meta Beaver Dam (Alliant service agreement 6680-TE-115, up to 220 MW), QTS, Cloverleaf and any campus the data center step lists.

Ownership to settle: MGE bought one third of RockGen in 2026 (stage 33 percent only if the closing is confirmed); Riverside has two EIA codes; the Port Washington owner company and WEC parent; Elm Road shares (We Energies about 83 percent, WPPI and MGE); West Campus (MGE and the University of Wisconsin); LSP-Whitewater owners; Sheboygan Falls (Sheboygan Power LLC, leased to Alliant).

Columbia Energy Center (Alliant, WPS, MGE): coal ends at the end of 2029 with a gas conversion study. Stage a conversion timepoint only on a filing or utility statement that commits to it; otherwise a watch item with the case plan option.
Burlington RICE is in Iowa, not Wisconsin. It is not a lead here.

L100000104269.text: Edgewater 5, Natalia Fretz's open comment thread on the start year: Alliant's May 2024 release says conversion in 2028, a March 2026 Sheboygan Press story says delayed to 2029, and GEM says 2030 (Amalia's value). Find Alliant's newest filing or release, settle the year, and say in the note that the thread can be closed. The EIA file lists the coal generator, so its operating status is not a conflict.

L100000104280.text: Weston 4, Natalia Fretz's open comment thread on the retirement year: the thread already settled on 2030 (coal kept as backup fuel only to the end of 2030, from the WEC Energy Group September 2025 update). Confirm that against the newest WEC document, say the thread can be closed, and settle the conversion year (EIA-860 2025 says 2029, WEC's May 2025 update says 2030). Do not type EIA plant 4130: it is New Lisbon in Juneau County, 116 km away, and the join matched it wrongly. Weston's code stays 4078.

L100000104274.text: Elm Road, Natalia Fretz's open comment thread on the retirement year: the thread settled on 2028 from Public Service Commission docket 5-CE-161 (filing 566031). Confirm against the October 2025 filing (coal kept as backup to 2030, no coal after 2032), say the thread can be closed, settle the gas start year, and fill the validation report's capacity, technology and carbon capture sources on units 1 and 2. EIA lists the coal generators as operating, which is not a conflict with the planned conversion row.

L100001083378.text: Forest Junction and Union Depot share the site and docket 5-CE-162 (engineering plan is filing 606657 of 2026-08-20). Get the application, the MW per unit (up to 1.2 GW and 750 MW), the alternate Woodville site and the in-service dates. Owner is Invenergy or its project companies until We Energies files to buy. Location is approximate; the engineering plan's site map places it.

L100001089647.text: See the Forest Junction task: same site and docket 5-CE-162. Location is approximate; use the engineering plan's site map.

L100001062057.text: Red Oak Ridge: docket 9837-CE-100, related 6630-BS-104; the certificate was approved 2026-10-15. The Commission page says up to 1,186 MW and the Town of Paris, while GEM says 5 x 242 = 1,210 MW and Somers. Use nameplate from the application, check the site, add the vote and written order to Status Detail and Latest Activity, and find We Energies' purchase application. EIA plant 70453 goes in as an ID for a person to type; generator ids go in a question.

L100001047813.text: Foundry Ridge: docket 9835-CE-100, certificate of October 2026, and We Energies' purchase application. EIA plant 70360 (generators FNDRD, FNRD2, FNRD3) is this plant; answer it in a question. It is a match, not an add.

L100001089648.text: Fox North: docket 6630-CE-319, pre-application, construction 2029 and operation late 2032. Read the engineering plan for the turbine model and MW.

L100001025603.text: South Oak Creek combustion turbines: docket 6630-CE-317. Settle construction progress and the in-service date (winter 2027 or summer 2028). The 2 Bcf LNG storage at Oak Creek is storage, not a power plant. GEM's fossil gas LNG fuel on these rows needs a question only if no document says the turbines burn regasified LNG. Coal units 7 and 8 retirement moved to the end of 2027; note that as site context only. EIA plant 4041 goes in as an ID for a person to type.

L100001047775.text: Paris RICE: docket 6630-CE-316 (1,768 documents). Settle construction progress and the in-service date. The Sierra Club 'Paris Internal Combustion Project' units 5 to 11 (seven at 19 MW) are these engines, which GEM holds as one 131.6 MW unit; answer in a question that names the docket. No new units.

L100001089674.text: Microsoft Mount Pleasant: reconcile GEM's three units (672 MW) with permits 24-DMM-092 and 25-MIN-113 and Amalia's note of 244 generators and 687 MW in the August 2026 application. Check the Mount Pleasant village agendas.

L100001089699.text: Vantage Lighthouse WI-1 at Port Washington: 45 diesel engines, about 87 MW, construction permit 25-MIN-094, operation permit 24618528A-F01 issued 2026-06-12 and under a lawsuit. Check the engine count and size per engine and whether later phases have permits.

L100000104693.text: Port Washington power station: docket 6630-CE-318 is a combustion turbine upgrade at this plant. Read it for the capacity and date changes. The owner company and WEC parent need a source. Amalia edited this plant in November 2026.

L100000407359.text: Nemadji Trail stays cancelled. L100000402374.text: Paris (WI): the Sierra Club 'Paris Internal Combustion Project' rows are the Paris RICE engines, not new units here. Answer with the Paris RICE docket and add no units.

L100000409233.text: Wheaton (Xcel): unit 6's EIP 'under construction' row is the repowering. Settle unit 7 (249.1 MW, operating 2026) and unit 8 (49 MW, operating 2025) from Xcel's Wisconsin filings and EIA, say whether the repowering replaced unit 6, and record generator 8 in a question.

L100000409271.text: French Island units 3 and 4: planned retirement 2030 (oil, 78.8 MW each). Check Xcel's Upper Midwest plan for the retirement and any replacement.

L100000402376.text: Neenah: EIA gives 185.5 MW per unit while GEM gives 220. Amalia set 220 from Alliant's 'about 440 MW after 2025 upgrades'; check that her notes give that source and leave her value unless a document disagrees.

L100000401635.text: Sheboygan Falls: EIA gives 173.4 MW per unit while GEM gives 220. Same rule as Neenah. Owner is Sheboygan Power LLC, leased to Alliant.

L100000402373.text: Germantown: EIA gives 71.2 MW for units 1 to 4 and 105.9 MW for unit 5, while GEM gives 61.2 and 91. Check the nameplate and report it with a source.

L100000104267.text: Blount Street units 6 and 7 timepoint 2: 2011 is the gas conversion year and EIA's 1957 and 1961 are the original coal years; answer with the source for 2011, which also clears the validation items (no data source for owner or location, no carbon capture source on units 6 and 7).

L100000104279.text: Valley units 1 and 2 timepoint 2: 2014 and 2015 are the gas conversion years and EIA's 1968 and 1969 are the original coal years; answer with a source for each year. Fill the validation items (no owner source, no carbon capture source).
